title: SpendAudit: Evaluating LLM Payment Auditors Against an Executable Policy
description: A 320-item benchmark of synthetic payment traces in which the right answer is computed, not judged. Every label comes from the deterministic spend policy in SOLVENT, and every scenario appears twice: once clean, and once with a prompt injection in the memo of the payment under review. Includes the working paper, data, prompts, judge outputs and a one-command recount script.
notes: Code is MIT; data, prompts and judge outputs are CC BY 4.0.
